summary: Recorded the negative control in the parent configuration account from receipt 3044e4e1ae284cf8abc323990e968c5c (event 33): after the same remove-and-re-add history, a snapshot taken once the widened configuration was committed carries five servers at index 20, and the node restarted from it recovers five servers matching the configuration in force, so the gap is conditional on a snapshot that predates the change.
